resources.title: OWD & Sharing Model Decision Worksheet
resources.description: The three-question OWD decision framework plus role-hierarchy and sharing-rule planning, applied per object -- pre-filled with Lesson 14's full Meridian Outfitters sales-org design (territory-based Private OWD, hierarchy rollup, co-sell sharing rule) as a worked reference.

resources.title: Permission Set vs. Profile Planning Template
resources.description: A grant-by-grant worksheet for deciding whether an access decision belongs on the baseline profile or an additive permission set/permission set group, with a worked muting example and the union-rule reminder that nothing at this layer can ever subtract access.

resources.title: Security Review & Audit Checklist
resources.description: The layered troubleshooting order for a specific reported access problem, plus a periodic access-review checklist covering stale users, broad View All/Modify All grants, profile sprawl, and OWD sanity checks -- grounded in the Brightwell Insurance Group audit case study's four real findings and its risk-based prioritization method.
